$comment: Sprint 13 Module 14: how every API route treats an Editor. allow: @Roles names EDITOR. draft-only: names EDITOR and assertEditorMayWrite allows drafts only. deny: @Roles without EDITOR (403, rbac.denied). open: no @Roles, any signed-in member; reason required. public: @Public, no session; reason says what authorizes it. Checked by editor-access.spec.ts and editor-access.guard.spec.ts; a new route without an entry fails them.
